verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AnythingLLM runs locally and keeps documents in an on-device knowledge base. Nothing in the pack documents an assistant memory store that users can inspect, edit, or delete, or that is kept in an open format. Local execution and a document knowledge base are related features, not memory management, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a privacy-first user, I can inspect, edit, and delete what the assistant has remembered — the memory store lives on my machine in an open format
